app.name: Cairn
app.recoveryDescription: The main vault is missing. Close Cairn and restore backups/previous.cairn in the vault folder.
auth.createDescription: Choose a master password of at least 12 characters. It can't be reset.
auth.unlockDescription: Enter your master password to open the vault.
errors.Storage: Couldn't read or save the vault. Check disk space and permissions, then unlock it again.
errors.InUse: The vault is already open in another instance of Cairn.
errors.AlreadyExists: A vault already exists. Unlock it to continue.
errors.Locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to continue.
errors.InvalidInput: Check the fields and their length. The master password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.InvalidVault: The vault file is damaged or its format is invalid. It was not replaced.
errors.UnsupportedVersion: This vault needs another version of Cairn.
errors.Randomness: Windows couldn't generate the random data Cairn needs. Try again.
errors.ChangedOnDisk: The vault changed on disk. Lock it and unlock it again before continuing.
entry.name: Name
entry.siteHint: Filled on this exact site. Write *.example.com to include its subdomains.
entry.notesUnchanged: The notes stay unchanged. Show the password before editing to change them.
entry.totpHint: The setup key or otpauth:// link a site gives when you turn on two-factor authentication.
entry.needsSecret: Enter a password, an authenticator key, or both.
entry.invalid: Check the fields. An authenticator key is a Base32 key or an otpauth://totp link.
generator.title: Password generator
add.title: New login
edit.title: Edit login
edit.description: The previous version stays in the vault backup.
remove.title: Delete “{name}”?
remove.description: The login leaves the vault. The backup of the previous version keeps it until the next change.
credentials.title: Logins
credentials.notesHidden: Show the password to read the notes.
credentials.notFoundHint: Try another name, site, or username.
credentials.emptyHint: Add a login to find it here.
authenticator.emptyHint: Add codes from a QR code, otpauth:// links, or a Google Authenticator export.
authenticator.removeKeepsLogin: The login keeps its password. The backup of the previous version keeps the key until the next change.
authenticator.removeDeletesEntry: This entry holds only the code, so it leaves the vault. The backup of the previous version keeps it until the next change.
authenticator.title: Add authenticator codes
authenticator.description: Paste a screenshot of a QR code with Ctrl+V, drop a picture here, or paste otpauth:// links. Google Authenticator's Transfer accounts export works too.
authenticator.noCode: No authenticator QR code in this picture.
authenticator.invalid: Cairn can't read these links. Codes based on a counter (HOTP) aren't supported.
browsers.conflict: Two browsers asked to pair at the same time, so Cairn refused both. If you asked from only one, something else on this computer tried to pair. Try again from the extension.
browsers.description: These browsers can fill your logins while the vault is unlocked.
browsers.empty: No browser is paired. Open the Cairn extension and choose Pair with Cairn.
browsers.removed: {name} can no longer fill your logins.
browsers.requestDescription: {name} asks to fill your logins on the sites they belong to.
browsers.requestHint: Approve only if the Cairn extension shows the same code. If you didn't ask for this, refuse.
browsers.title: Paired browsers
extension.dev: Development builds don't ship the extension. Set it up with the dev scripts in docs/development.md.
extension.missing: The extension folder is missing. Reinstall Cairn to restore it.
extension.once: Do this once per Helium profile. Updates replace the files in place; reload the extension in chrome://extensions afterwards.
extension.steps.2: Choose Load unpacked and select this folder.
settings.languageHint: The language of the window and the tray menu.
settings.title: Settings
startup.disabled: Development builds don't start with Windows.
startup.hint: Cairn waits in the tray when you sign in, with the vault locked.
startup.title: Start with Windows
update.hints.nightly: A build of the latest changes every night. Less tested.
update.leaveNightly: This nightly build moves to stable at the next stable release.
update.unavailable: Updates are unavailable in this build.
